text: Surface water drainage shall be designed for the rainfall intensity of DP-CASE-0006 (10 min, 25-year return) using the rational method with runoff coefficients of 0.9 for paved and roofed areas, 0.6 for gravelled areas and 0.3 for landscaped areas; pipe flow depth at design flow not more than 80 % of the diameter and velocities between 0.75 m/s and 4 m/s; the 100-year overland flow path shall be checked to keep floor levels dry.
